title: Proceed to Checkout and Review Delivery, Billing and Order Details

scenarios.title: Validate unauthenticated user is prompted to register/login when proceeding to checkout

steps.action:
Preconditions:
1. Customer is not authenticated.
2. Add a product to the cart (e.g., via Product Catalog).
expected: Preconditions are met

steps.action: Navigate to the Shopping Cart page.
expected: The Shopping Cart page is displayed with the added product(s).

steps.action: Select 'Proceed To Checkout'.
expected: The user is redirected to the 'Register / Login' page or an equivalent path for authentication/registration before proceeding with checkout.

scenarios.title: Verify authenticated user sees Address Details and Review Your Order sections on checkout page

steps.action:
Preconditions:
1. Customer is authenticated.
2. Add a product to the cart (e.g., via Product Catalog).
expected: Preconditions are met

steps.action: Navigate to the Shopping Cart page.
expected: The Shopping Cart page is displayed with the added product(s).

steps.action: Select 'Proceed To Checkout'.
expected: The checkout page is displayed, containing both 'Address Details' and 'Review Your Order' sections.

scenarios.title: Validate delivery address matches registration address at checkout

steps.action:
Preconditions:
1. Register a new customer account with delivery address: '123 Main St, Anytown, CA 90210'.
2. Authenticate the customer.
3. Add a product to the cart (e.g., via Product Catalog).
expected: Preconditions are met

steps.action:
Test Setup & Data:
Registered Address: 123 Main St, Anytown, CA 90210
expected: Required test setup and data are ready for use.

steps.action: Navigate to the Shopping Cart page and select 'Proceed To Checkout'.
expected: The checkout page is displayed.

steps.action: Review the 'Address Details' section on the checkout page.
expected: The delivery address displayed in the 'Address Details' section is '123 Main St, Anytown, CA 90210', matching the registered address.

scenarios.title: Validate ability to enter order comment and select Place Order

steps.action:
Preconditions:
1. Authenticate customer.
2. Add a product to the cart.
3. Navigate to the checkout page and ensure 'Address Details' and 'Review Your Order' sections are displayed.
expected: Preconditions are met

steps.action:
Test Setup & Data:
Order Comment: 'Please deliver after 5 PM.'
expected: Required test setup and data are ready for use.

steps.action: Locate the 'Order Comment' input field (or equivalent) on the checkout page.
expected: An input field for 'Order Comment' is visible.

steps.action: Enter a comment: 'Please deliver after 5 PM.'
expected: The comment 'Please deliver after 5 PM.' is successfully entered into the field.

steps.action: Locate and select the 'Place Order' button.
expected: The 'Place Order' button is visible and clickable, and selecting it initiates the order placement process (e.g., navigates to the payment step).

scenarios.title: Verify cart contents are preserved when an unauthenticated user logs in via checkout path

steps.action:
Preconditions:
1. Customer is not authenticated.
2. Register a new customer account.
3. Add 'Men Tshirt' (quantity 2) to the cart.
expected: Preconditions are met

steps.action:
Test Setup & Data:
Product: 'Men Tshirt', Quantity: 2
expected: Required test setup and data are ready for use.

steps.action: Navigate to the Shopping Cart page and select 'Proceed To Checkout'.
expected: User is presented with the 'Register / Login' path.

steps.action: Choose to 'Login' and enter valid credentials for the registered account.
expected: Authentication completes successfully.

steps.action: Navigate to the Shopping Cart page or proceed with checkout (if automatically redirected).
expected: The 'Men Tshirt' (quantity 2) product is still present in the cart, confirming pre-login contents were preserved.

scenarios.title: Handle empty cart when attempting to proceed to checkout

steps.action:
Preconditions:
1. Ensure the shopping cart is empty.
expected: Preconditions are met

steps.action: Navigate to the Shopping Cart page.
expected: The Shopping Cart page is displayed, indicating it is empty.

steps.action: Attempt to interact with the 'Proceed To Checkout' action (e.g., click a disabled button, or observe message).
expected: The 'Proceed To Checkout' button is disabled, or an informative message (e.g., 'Your cart is empty. Please add products to proceed to checkout.') is displayed, preventing advancement to checkout.
